mapper.select: SELECT member_id, farm_name, representative_name, username, password, created_at, phone_number, email, farm_address, farm_address_detail, main_crop, farm_description, certified_at, farm_business_number, certification_status, updated_at FROM farm_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT member_id, username, password FROM farm_member WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM farm_member WHERE username = #{username})
mapper.update: UPDATE farm_member SET password = #{newHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND password = #{oldHash} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM farm_member WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO farm_member ( farm_name, representative_name, username, password, created_at, phone_number, email, farm_address, farm_address_detail, main_crop, farm_description, certified_at, farm_business_number, certification_status ) VALUES ( #{farmName}, #{representativeName}, #{username}, #{password}, NOW(), #{phoneNumber}, #{email}, #{farmAddress}, #{farmAddressDetail}, #{mainCrop}, #{farmDescription}, #{certifiedAt}, #{farmBusinessNumber}, #{certificationStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE farm_member SET representative_name = #{representativeName}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, farm_address = #{farmAddress}, farm_address_detail = #{farmAddressDetail}, main_crop = #{mainCrop}, farm_description = #{farmDescription}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE farm_member SET farm_name = #{farmName}, farm_address = #{farmAddress}, farm_address_detail = #{farmAddressDetail}, main_crop = #{mainCrop}, farm_description = #{farmDescription}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE farm_member SET representative_name = #{representativeName}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE farm_member SET farm_business_number = #{businessNumber}, certification_status = '인증 대기중', updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND certified_at IS NULL AND (certification_status IS NULL OR certification_status = '미인증')
